$comment: Section 21 (External Commuting & Housing) + A6 amendment (§21's finite-era-scaled-capacity ruling, docs/METROPOLIS-MASTER-v2.1.md 'R6 -- Out-commuter tax farming exploit' section) of docs/METROPOLIS-MASTER-v2.1.md, transcribed into a schema-valid v1 dataset for the three named off-map job pools. FEAT-047 / data.modes-naming, ASM-274. Placeholder disclosure (ASM-393, per Aaron's standing balance-number regime -- see project memory 'Balance number regime'): every capacityByEra and wageMicropounds figure in this file is a placeholder pending M2 Batch tuning, NOT a literature-cited estimate -- A6 states mechanism only ('finite, era-scaled capacity... bounded and slowly growing') with no spec-given magnitude, unlike modes.json's coefficients which at least cite a structural literature source for the nest-tree convention. See docs/design/modes-naming-external-schema.md for the full field reference.
eraConvention: era corresponds to the game's milestone/tier index (M0-ENG); capacityByEra covers eras 1 through 12 (the full milestone range data/buildings.json's unlock milestones span) so era 5 -- the tier §21 names as when the external rail station unlocks -- is always covered, not merely reached as a boundary case.
moneyConvention: wageMicropounds is int64 micro-pounds (1 GBP = 1,000,000 micropounds, M0-ENG §1.2), matching data/market.json's money-representation convention exactly -- never a float. Interpreted as a monthly gross wage per off-map job held.
